records.title: Represent versioned DTCG dimensions
records.body:
# Represent versioned DTCG dimensions

## Meaning
For the checked DTCG 2025.10 format, a dimension uses a numeric value and unit object. Do not copy the historical string-value example as a conforming representation. Preserve semantic token intent when replacing its serialization.
## Applicability and exceptions
This is version-bound format knowledge. Other application formats can validly use strings. Recheck the actual target specification before implementation. A parsing pass is not complete schema/resolver interoperability.
## Evidence boundary
The new report and intake selected-primary check qualify the historical example. No resolver or application was executed in this pilot.

records.title: Preserve identity when names change
records.body:
# Preserve identity when names change

## Meaning
Use stable keys or mapping identity to find existing definitions before matching a mutable display name. A rename is not permission to create a duplicate. Detect obsolete mappings and reconcile actual state before writing.
## Applicability and exceptions
Figma native identities are not an unlimited cross-file/recreation guarantee. A separate canonical identity is a proposed architecture choice only when consumers justify it. Names remain useful for human discovery.
## Evidence boundary
Proposed mapping/maintenance practices. Repeatability requires observed execution, not just this stored guidance.

records.title: Choose sufficient token layers
records.body:
# Choose sufficient token layers

## Meaning
Primitive, semantic and optional component tokens serve different jobs. Each layer must justify its maintenance cost. Semantic roles should preserve intent. Component tokens are useful when a stable local contract needs them, not because every system must have three layers.
## Applicability and exceptions
Use when selecting or extending a token architecture. Small initial scope is not a product-size ceiling. A large existing system may justify more structure. Do not infer that avoiding layers always improves quality.
## Evidence boundary
Conditional architectural guidance, not an experimentally optimal layer count.

records.title: Historical string dimension fixture
Interpret complete semantic names
records.body:
# Interpret complete semantic names

## Meaning
A repeated word such as Primary does not establish ambiguity by itself. Inspect the complete namespace, role and context. Retain, minimally revise or replace names according to actual ambiguity and migration cost.
## Applicability and exceptions
Use for naming review and migration. A local preference for more explicit names is valid locally, not evidence that every Primary name is defective. Screenshot scale numbers do not establish opacity or underlying bindings.
## Evidence boundary
The foundation used a transcription of naming tables. Exact paints and bindings were unavailable. This is conditional practice, not a naming standard.

## Role, tone and surface
Default, Common or another namespace level is useful only when it adds a
needed distinction. Inverse can describe a foreground on a contextual surface,
not the global dark theme. A positive numeric delta, successful operation and
destructive action are different semantics even when their colors resemble one
another. Do not rename them into a universal status vocabulary automatically.
Numeric palette steps alone do not establish alpha or measured contrast.

records.title: Keep native state with its real owner
records.body:
# Keep native state with its real owner

## Meaning
For Compose, hoist state to the appropriate common owner based on actual readers and writers. Expose immutable state and events where appropriate. Internal transient presentation state and domain/business state are different concerns.
## Applicability and exceptions
Native platform guidance, not a single cross-platform component API. SwiftUI has its own ownership mechanisms. Check actual framework/deployment conditions. No native compilation or execution is demonstrated by a design variant.
## Evidence boundary
Qualified report and selected official documentation check, no compiled native example in this pilot.

## Lifetime and ownership
A transient visual state can stay local; a screen draft, persistence obligation
or domain operation needs the owner and lifetime its behavior requires.
Recreation/restoration and ordinary display state are different properties.
SwiftUI and Compose express ownership differently; a similar-looking Figma
variant supplies neither runtime model. The shortened source examples omit
production lifecycle and save/error handling and were not compiled.

records.title: Select Figma/code ownership by actual consumers
records.body:
# Select Figma/code ownership by actual consumers

## Meaning
Figma-led, code-led and shared-token routes are alternatives. Choose by actual value/API ownership, consumers and maintenance needs. Figma-led work can be appropriate for a design-heavy start. Code-led work can favor reproducibility. Shared tokens can serve multiple consumers without making Figma and code symmetrically authoritative.
## Applicability and exceptions
No universal registry, token service or framework follows. Define update direction and transforms explicitly. A Figma-led start still needs stable semantic names and mapping, so later repository ownership is a migration rather than a semantic redesign. The platform reports lacked the companion foundation, so provisional examples need role/state/context/API reconciliation before combination.
## Evidence boundary
Architectural alternatives and conditions, not proof of a built synchronized library or demonstrated arbitrary scale.

## Representation boundaries
Assign authority by decision, not one artifact for everything. Token values,
visual anatomy, runtime API/behavior, domain semantics and mappings can have
different owners. A mapping or editable capture is neither an implementation
nor automatic synchronization. Actual capability, account access, library
availability and publication are separate. Missing tool-returned mappings can
mean unavailable/deactivated/moved access or identity, not an absent component.
Inspect relevant evidence before creating a replacement. Concrete tool/seat/API
claims in the reports are dated, not present capability guarantees.

records.title: Keep asynchronous web state distinct from disabled
records.body:
# Keep asynchronous web state distinct from disabled

## Meaning
A pending asynchronous operation is not automatically ordinary disabled behavior. Preserve feedback, focus and the accepted interaction contract. A Figma visual variant does not establish runtime state or business logic.
## Applicability and exceptions
Read for browser components. React Aria documents specific pending behavior, including retained focusability and announcements. Do not generalize that library API into every custom control or native platform.
## Evidence boundary
Source/intake documentation check only. No browser, accessibility or user test was run here.

records.title: Re-read after uncertain writes
records.body:
# Re-read after uncertain writes

## Meaning
An interrupted response does not prove a component write did not happen. Re-read actual state before retrying, preserve manually owned fields and compare against the known base. Detect conflicts rather than overwriting a concurrent human edit.
## Applicability and exceptions
Applies to authorized Figma/code mutations. Use stable identity and observed state. Do not invent atomic transactions, distributed rollback or automatic conflict resolution from the availability of a write tool.
## Evidence boundary
Proposed reliability practice in the supplied reports. Local file checks cannot prove Figma execution reliability.

## Owned regions and repeatability
Separate generated output, manually owned implementation and generated-once
scaffolds that have since acquired an owner. Regeneration is not permission to
erase manual work. Compare the actual current state, known baseline and desired
state; distinguish a true no-op, missing work and an overlapping conflict.
Preserve independent manual changes and continue unrelated authorized work.
A recorded journal can support recovery without becoming a mandatory new file
or providing atomicity. Re-read identities, mappings and affected consumers
after interruption; repeat only missing operations whose safety is established.
Rollback of a dependency or export is not proof that every external side effect
was undone. These are proposed maintenance practices, not observed tool guarantees.

records.title: Express semantic belonging before adjusting spacing
triggers: заголовок относится не к тому блоку
records.body:
# Express semantic belonging before adjusting spacing

## Meaning
First identify which object a heading, label or explanation belongs to. Let spacing, alignment and economical emphasis express that relationship. Resolve duplicated labels by the distinct information they contribute, not by deleting every secondary label. Diagnose the relationship before choosing whether to reduce or increase a gap.

## Applicability and exceptions
Use for visible grouping and nesting across interfaces. A balanced layout is valid when it preserves meaning; unequal groups need not be padded or shortened to equal counts. Explicit current Fab policy owns authoring decisions, including meaning before decorative economy. This knowledge does not prescribe a fixed section sequence or ban expressive headings.

## Source conflict and evidence boundary
R014 gives a 2:1 spacing recipe and R040 even says to reverse it; these are preserved historical statements, not a reliable universal correction. A numeric ratio alone cannot diagnose belonging. The qualified practice is relational; source claims are not independently validated comprehension outcomes. Current interface policy remains separate from this evidence.

records.title: Align named objects to a contextual anchor
records.body:
# Align named objects to a contextual anchor

## Meaning
Identify the actual reference: text edge, container edge, baseline, photograph or optical center. Align the requested objects to that anchor while preserving meaningful reading order. An object can share an axis without sharing a width, container or number of columns.

## Applicability and exceptions
Use for local alignment and coherent composition. A mathematically equal grid can still look wrong; justified optical adjustments remain possible. An explicitly requested redesign can change columns and ordering. Scope authorization and how to ask about a material ambiguity belong to current interface-authoring policy, not to a research report.

## Evidence boundary
The source proposes anchoring and optical exceptions but does not establish fixed pixel offsets or a universal reading path. Do not infer that all unaligned objects are defects. Inspect actual rendered relationships; source geometry and a token inventory are supporting evidence only.

records.title: Reuse text roles without erasing useful differences
records.body:
# Reuse text roles without erasing useful differences

## Meaning
Choose styles by the reading role: heading, explanation, card title, control or note. Reuse a coherent role across equivalent instances before introducing another near-identical variant. Choose font, size, weight, measure, line height and tracking together.

## Applicability and exceptions
A price, receipt identifier, display heading or justified optical case can need a distinct style. Equal numbers do not erase different semantics, and different responsive values do not automatically mean different roles. Reuse sufficient shared definitions rather than demanding a full token architecture or a fixed role count.

## Source qualifications and evidence boundary
The source's 4px grid, fixed container padding, 150–175% leading and 50–75-character measure are contextual examples, not universal validity thresholds. Native defaults do not select browser metrics. Current interface and target policy own actual output. An inventory can expose duplication but cannot prove readable rendering or visitor understanding.

records.title: Fit actual text without hiding meaning
records.body:
# Fit actual text without hiding meaning

## Meaning
Inspect actual representative content: long names, Cyrillic and mixed scripts, punctuation, numbers/units and relevant larger text. Let layout grow or wrap when possible. Preserve meaningful distinctions and necessary conditions when shortening; fitting the box alone is not success.

## Applicability and exceptions
Truncation can be legitimate when the task still exposes the needed meaning or an accessible full-text route. Do not forbid all truncation or make every unit unbreakable. Deliberate breaks and short nonbreaking units need checks at their affected widths. Browser reflow, user text-spacing overrides and native text scaling are different mechanisms.

## Evidence boundary
The historical fixed Russian expansion percentage and numerical typography recipes are not verified guarantees. A normal screenshot proves neither all enlargement states nor comprehension. Consult actual target guidance for version-sensitive behavior. Source-preserving formatting does not independently verify scientific or platform claims.

## Component context and enlargement
Choose constraints from actual content and the space the parent gives the
component; a viewport threshold is appropriate for a viewport-level decision.
Nested overlays, direction and theme context need relevant inspection rather
than assuming the parent page proves them. Browser zoom, text enlargement and
a narrow emulated viewport are related but different test conditions.
[WCAG reflow guidance](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/reflow.html)
allows exceptions where two-dimensional layout is necessary for use or meaning;
do not flatten a diagram or table merely to apply a universal single-column rule.
Its applicable content still needs a usable reading route. Native scaling remains
target-specific. No fixed expansion percentage or universal breakpoint follows.

records.title: Separate product organization, surfaces and task paths
records.body:
# Separate product organization, surfaces and task paths

## Meaning
Information organization answers what belongs together; surface composition answers what information and controls exist in a working context; navigation answers how contexts open; a scenario follows one task through actions and outcomes. Several tasks may share a surface and a task may cross several surfaces. A new feature or use case does not automatically require another screen. Keep object/surface identities consistent across views and review affected task paths when a structural choice changes.

## Applicability and exceptions
Use when relating accepted behavior to structure. A separate surface can be justified by an independent purpose, meaningful re-entry, sustained work, transaction or domain boundary. Atomic contextual actions may only need feedback in place. Access priority depends on frequency, importance, urgency and context; inferred frequency is a hypothesis. Consequence/risk and navigation prominence are different axes.

## Evidence and authority
These are qualified distinctions and contextual design heuristics, not a universal screen count, navigation-depth threshold or mandatory map pair. Source-local artifact names and worked examples do not prescribe a product workflow. Existing capability policy owns actual artifacts and edits. A valid or creator-approved map does not establish reachability comprehension, real usage frequency or usability.


## Semantic purpose and representation
A semantic surface can be an overview, collection, search result, object detail,
workspace, creation/editing task, management context, decision or meaningful
result. These are possible roles, not an inventory to implement. A bare success
message need not be a separate destination. Related contexts can coexist in
panes on a wider window while remaining sequential on narrower ones.
Keep navigation, peer switching, temporary opening, containment and documentation
references distinguishable in diagrams. A link to a detailed flow is not an extra
runtime action, and grouping is not automatically a navigation edge. Color alone
need not carry the relation. Source card/legend syntax remains an example.
Actual Canvas generation belongs to its existing owner.

records.title: Preserve the caller and unfinished work across transitions
records.body:
# Preserve the caller and unfinished work across transitions

## Meaning
A transition carries the actual object and relevant date, filter, selection, input and origin. Know which action commits which change, where return goes and what remains after cancellation or resumption. Back, Close, Cancel and Undo have different meanings even when their controls look similar. Shared behavior still needs each caller's concrete continuation.

## Applicability and exceptions
Include alternate entry or resume only when the product supports it; do not invent notifications, deep links or autosave. Explicit save/discard, draft/autosave and immediate application/undo are alternatives chosen by the accepted model. A child operation may commit independently: canceling its parent does not automatically delete that saved child. The actual domain rule decides the boundary, not a generic cancellation slogan.

## Evidence and authority
The source transition-contract template is a thinking aid, not required metadata on every link or another registry. Native back stacks, browser history/focus and actual persistence need target-specific evidence. A diagram cannot prove OS restoration or remote write guarantees. If commit/cancel meaning is unresolved, surface that behavior question rather than inventing a screen to hide it. Current process and diagram generation remain outside this knowledge's authority.


## Exit and interruption semantics
Back returns through navigation, Close dismisses a temporary surface, Cancel
abandons uncommitted work, Save commits, Done completes the current task, and
Undo compensates for an applied change when supported. Gesture dismissal should
not conceal a destructive command. Autosave is a legitimate exception to an
explicit-save model, not an assumed guarantee; closing then need not roll back.
Check supported exits, including system gestures, another external entry and
interruption, when they could lose relevant input or change the result. Protect
draft input that cannot be reconstructed from the committed model according
to the accepted contract. Restoration need not preserve everything forever.
A browser's history can lead outside the app; a native Back preview and actual
destination should agree under the applicable platform behavior. Verify those
properties on the actual target rather than inferring them from arrow labels.

records.title: Classify scope findings and preserve a usable increment
records.body:
# Classify scope findings and preserve a usable increment

## Meaning
A bounded increment promises observable capabilities/outcomes for someone under stated limits. Relate included behavior to its basis and a way to check it, and relate added screens/actions back to their justification. A minimal usable outcome and its dependencies matter more than an arbitrary collection of features.

## Applicability and exceptions
Distinguish a lost accepted in-scope requirement, a known explicitly excluded item, an unresolved decision and a newly discovered candidate. Restore lost coverage or explicitly revisit scope; keep a deliberate exclusion visible without implementing it; expose a material unknown instead of filling it with guessed UI; a new review idea needs a scope decision before inclusion. A legal/contractual basis does not need a fabricated user job. No fixed MVP size, phase count or compulsory requirements database follows.

## Evidence and authority
The source proposes scope/traceability heuristics, not a validated business-value metric or universal stage sequence. Use existing accepted project records; a diagram or knowledge note cannot approve a feature. Repair the earliest false assumption and affected dependents while preserving unrelated accepted work. An unresolved question blocks the parts whose promised outcome depends on it, not automatically all independent work.

records.title: Separate domain state, attempted action and known result
records.body:
# Separate domain state, attempted action and known result

## Meaning
Keep durable domain status, attempted action, execution plan, known operation result and current UI representation distinguishable. A response lost after a possible side effect is unknown, not a confirmed rejection, proof of non-application or automatically safe retry. Reconcile the same attempt when that uncertainty can affect duplication or irreversible effects.

## Applicability and exceptions
An atomic local operation or authoritative proof of non-application may not need a separate unknown-outcome path. This conceptual distinction does not require five code objects, a new domain enum or a distributed-operation framework. Waiting feedback and disabled behavior are UI questions; they cannot establish what happened remotely. Cancellation can refer to editing, an attempt or the entity; the domain contract must distinguish them.

## Partial effects and provisional presentation
When several user-significant effects can commit separately, expose the known partial result and recovery rather than assuming a generic Error means nothing happened. Atomicity or compensation is an implementation guarantee requiring evidence. Optimistic presentation remains provisional: define rejection/conflict handling and avoid rolling back later user edits. Closing a view or stopping its wait does not by itself cancel remote execution.

## Evidence and authority
The source explicitly labels this decomposition as synthesis, not a universal standard. It does not implement server deduplication, transactional cancellation, reconciliation or persistence. The linked pending meaning retains its browser/library scope; the linked recovery meaning retains its authorized design/code-mutation scope. Neither is generalized into a remote business guarantee by this association.

records.title: Choose evidence for the promised decision, not a state quota
records.body:
# Choose evidence for the promised decision, not a state quota

## Meaning
Coverage is relative to accepted scope and material risk. A role, state, datum, environment or surface deserves a separate case when it changes permission, action, transition, outcome, necessary representation, preservation/recovery or a consequential side effect. Prefer meaningful paths and discriminating boundaries to a full Cartesian product or a fixed number of states per screen.

## Applicability and exceptions
Select relevant alternate entries, cancellation and failure/recovery, rather than every imaginable case. A small coherent local scenario can be sufficient; a large set of screens with an unhandled critical outcome is not made complete by its size. Fixtures describe data/domain state; condition toggles describe environment/response. Neither every fixture nor every prototype needs all toggles. Pairwise coverage can help for suitable factors but cannot replace domain-transition or high-risk review.

## Evidence and stopping boundary
Ask what evidence is adequate for the next actual promise. Source/structure checks, rendered output, executable behavior, human understanding and production/platform guarantees are distinct. An appropriate cheap check may settle a limited question; a consequential unknown must be resolved or explicitly block its dependent promise. Remaining findings need a disposition, not a universal coverage percentage. The report's sequence and matrices are optional aids, not new stages or obligatory records. Current capabilities retain their process ownership.


## Applicability and check ownership
A state needs an actual mechanism. Legitimate absence can justify empty,
observable waiting loading, a possible failed read/write recovery, and an
uncertain side effect reconciliation. Missing detail is not automatically an
empty collection. Local deterministic work need not invent offline or unknown.
Repeated side effects matter where repetition can occur and change the result.
Behavior models explain allowed outcomes, structure reachable entry/result/
return, representative composition content/action gaps, interaction sequence
and understanding, and real integration checks their actual properties.
A command/stdout/stderr or API endpoint/response can be the observable surface
for nonvisual tools. No fixed sequence of stages follows.
Evidence strength is question-relative rather than one universal ladder.
Observed expectations can expose a conflict without overruling a domain contract.
Automation can inspect structured consistency, but cannot invent an unknown
domain rule or conclude that a person understood the result.

records.title: Bound a technical dependency by its observable promise
records.body:
# Bound a technical dependency by its observable promise

## Meaning
Distinguish a desired user-visible guarantee, a known environment constraint, a technical unknown that could change behavior and an operation simulated for review. A technical choice becomes a product dependency when it can change access, success truth, data lifetime, timing, recovery, consistency or external permission. Record enough promise/unknown/impact/evidence context in the existing project evidence to make that boundary usable.

## Applicability and exceptions
An unknown database/framework choice may be deferred when plausible alternatives preserve the same observable behavior, recovery and lifetime. If uncertainty can make a dependent promise false, resolve it, narrow that promise or mark that part blocked before asserting feasibility. Independent work can continue; a clearly labeled concept with an unknown can still be reviewed. No compulsory spike, full backend or second dependency registry follows.

## Evidence boundary
A spike answers a bounded question and stops when evidence supports retaining, limiting, changing or deferring the promise; it is not automatically a production feature. Simulated success may answer an interaction question but cannot independently verify the simulated property. Appropriate evidence depends on the actual decision, as qualified by coverage-sufficiency. This is source synthesis, not a new capability workflow or platform guarantee.

records.title: Separate local durability, backup, transfer and replica agreement
triggers: локально сохранено но ещё не синхронизировано
records.body:
# Separate local durability, backup, transfer and replica agreement

## Meaning
Current-form input, durable local commit, queued work, remote acceptance and replica agreement are different facts. Define which fact makes a particular Saved/Syncing claim true. Navigation, reload, app restart, device reboot, reinstall and another device require different lifetime evidence. Backup, export, transfer, replication and access recovery are distinct promises even when one implementation supports several.

## Applicability and exceptions
A local-first contract can legitimately call a durable local commit Saved while replicas remain pending. Server-authoritative behavior can require remote confirmation instead. A reload demonstration proves only its observed boundary. Cross-device use requires some replica/access association, but does not logically mandate a visible account, central user database or permanent connection. Identity, sharing, revocation and recovery still need their actual requirements; alternatives are not automatically sufficient.

## Evidence boundary
Do not select a storage framework, sync topology, account model or conflict policy merely by reading this meaning. Storage quotas, backup rules and lifecycle behavior are target/version dependent. The supplied report preserves examples, not independently verified guarantees of any implementation. Verify the exact lifetime or multi-client property promised rather than using one save screenshot as evidence of all durability.


## Data authority and replica semantics
Local-only, local-first and cloud-backed are operational descriptions, not three
mutually exclusive architectures for an entire product. Different objects or
operations can use different authority arrangements. A local copy, remote
authority, operation state and replication metadata are distinct facts.
Convergence of a replicated data structure does not automatically resolve
business meaning, ownership, deletion or incompatible decisions. Define the
actual conflict/recovery promise before treating a synchronization mechanism as
proof of correctness.

records.title: Limit network and error effects to the broken guarantee
records.body:
# Limit network and error effects to the broken guarantee

## Meaning
Assess connectivity and failure by operation and promised result. Network failure need not disable independent local creation, editing or search. Identify what remains usable, pending, readable but not refreshable, stale or genuinely impossible. Expose the failure at the narrowest level that accurately describes the affected guarantee.

## Applicability and exceptions
A local collection with unavailable sync may need status feedback rather than an application-wide block. If the whole selected task actually requires unavailable remote data and no valid local alternative exists, a blocking state can be appropriate. Do not invent a fallback where it cannot deliver the promised task. Online data can be stale; an offline copy can be adequate under an accepted freshness rule. No universal staleness threshold follows.

## Evidence boundary
Error placement is a contextual heuristic, not proof of independent operation or a ban on global errors. Actual authorization, durability and remote outcomes need their own evidence. Partial remote effects and safe retry belong to operation-outcome; do not relabel them as mere connectivity failures. A prototype network toggle must not manufacture failure by disabling unrelated local capabilities.

records.title: Match external capability claims to the property actually checked
triggers: нужно ли устройство для каждого макета
records.body:
# Match external capability claims to the property actually checked

## Meaning
Permissions, scheduled work, notifications, widgets, billing and external services have lifecycle and authority beyond a drawn screen. Choose the behavior/promise first, then establish what the target environment permits and which operation actually ran. Keep real and simulated operations, tested lifetime, conditions, allowed conclusions and unresolved constraints identifiable.

## Applicability and exceptions
A permission-denied explanation may be reviewed as layout without a physical device. Delivery timing, real system prompts/gestures, hardware or restore behavior can require the actual platform/environment when a simulator does not represent the property sufficiently. A consequential server guarantee may need a minimal service probe, not an entire backend. Replica-conflict claims need independent clients/replicas, not two views of one local fixture. No device check for every screen, backend spike for every app or universal fidelity ladder follows.

## Evidence boundary
Documentation can establish supported possibilities but not local account access or operational reliability. A timer, fake entitlement, network toggle or persuasive animation cannot prove delivery, durability, concurrency, purchase recovery or platform approval. Exact OS/SDK/store rules in the report remain dated and need current primary verification before implementation. This meaning does not choose APIs or assert a platform is presently capable.


## Keeping a prototype and handoff honest
Choose role, look-and-feel or implementation questions explicitly rather than
treating fidelity as overall completeness. Record which operations are real,
which simulated, which conditions/data can be invoked, what survives lifecycle
changes and what conclusions are permitted. These can live in existing notes,
not a new obligatory contract file.
Implementation handoff needs observable invariants, state truth, relevant
dependency evidence with conditions/date and intentionally deferred choices.
When new evidence changes a prerequisite, result or guarantee, review affected
behavior/scope/state and simulation labels. A closed technical question can
leave the product unchanged. Do not silently replace a remaining unknown with
a convincing simulated success.

records.title: Choose places and temporary tasks from actual context
records.body:
# Choose places and temporary tasks from actual context

## Meaning
Choose a primary context, drill-down path, peer destinations, overview or temporary task by the person's actual work and context ownership. Top-level places answer where work happens; commands initiate work. A dashboard is useful when overview of different states and choosing work is itself a task, not just because many features exist.

## Applicability and exceptions
A dominant context can remain one main surface; meaningful peer contexts can justify persistent navigation. Collection-to-object-to-part work can justify a stack. A short parent-bound task, a deep temporary task and one blocking decision have different presentation tradeoffs. No form-always-sheet rule follows; a long or independent task may need a larger or persistent surface. A dashboard, tabs or dialog can be justified when their actual role warrants it.

## Evidence boundary
These are contextual synthesis and platform examples, not a unique IA, compulsory number of destinations, navigation-depth limit or universal component binding. Source-specific platform numeric defaults remain dated and outside this meaning. Preserve accepted domain behavior and caller semantics; inspect relevant current target guidance before selecting an actual component. Sufficient structural information for a next decision does not require designing the whole app.

records.title: Keep commands and settings with the object they affect
records.body:
# Keep commands and settings with the object they affect

## Meaning
Identify the affected collection, object, temporary operation, application/account or operating system before placing a control. A collection's filter/search/bulk actions, an object's properties/history/actions and a temporary operation's input have different owners. App-wide preferences and OS-owned capabilities are not interchangeable with object-specific settings.

## Applicability and exceptions
An object's notification rule can belong to that object while an app-wide mode and OS permission belong elsewhere. A global policy can legitimately need a central entry; a shared service can back local controls without moving their user-facing ownership. Local placement can need an overflow or secondary entry when the object surface is crowded. Do not create another screen merely to keep a card visually clean.

## Evidence boundary
This is a contextual ownership heuristic from the mobile report, not a universal menu hierarchy or proof that every local action must remain permanently visible. Platform permission/settings behavior needs actual environment evidence. The linked Figma/code ownership unit concerns a different ownership axis and does not dictate product navigation or access rights.


## Object work versus app settings
Detail describes the current object, Edit the proposed change, Create a new
object in formation, and History past events. Required initial setup belongs
to the creation/first-use task when it is needed to make the object usable,
rather than automatically to global Settings. Cross-object activity can be a
separate app-level context when people actually work with it that way.

records.title: Treat keyboard, focus and available window as interaction context
records.body:
# Treat keyboard, focus and available window as interaction context

## Meaning
For relevant input flows consider initial focus and whether opening the keyboard immediately helps; visible active field/error; Next/Done behavior; safe keyboard dismissal; focus return; and whether a fixed action obscures input. Adapt to the available window/context rather than assuming a full-screen phone from the device label.

## Applicability and exceptions
Autofocus is not always helpful; some entry contexts justify it. Window changes, relevant larger text, long content and supported rotations can affect composition. A local format check and server-dependent validation have different truth boundaries. A form-level error summary can complement, not replace, the field's actionable error. Use the existing text-adaptation meaning for shared wrapping/content preservation instead of a second text rule set.

## Evidence boundary
A viewport simulation does not prove native keyboard/IME, autofill, focus/assistive semantics or lifecycle restoration. A drawn icon is not its actual hit region. Platform units, target-size thresholds and scaling mechanisms are not interchangeable; exact requirements need current applicable guidance and environment checks. This meaning supplies questions, not a mandatory keyboard test for a view with no input.

records.title: Preserve intent while re-evaluating target-specific behavior
records.body:
# Preserve intent while re-evaluating target-specific behavior

## Meaning
Retain the accepted task, domain intent and meaningful state when moving between targets, then re-evaluate navigation/history, input, permissions, window adaptation and accessibility under the actual environment. A browser-built prototype does not change a native target into a web product. Mobile web is a browser surface with its own behavior and evidence boundaries.

## Applicability and exceptions
A browser candidate can help inspect selected paths, labels and composition without proving native system Back/gestures, permission lifecycle, keyboard, assistive semantics, restoration or hardware behavior. For a mobile-web target it can be closer to implementation, but actual target browsers and relevant mobile conditions still matter. Physical devices or platform documentation are needed for the dependent property, not automatically every screen.

## Evidence boundary
The report's OS/API versions, numeric thresholds and current component recommendations are dated source claims, not maintained guarantees here. Shared appearance or token equality alone cannot establish equivalent behavior. Stop broad guideline reading when the active structural question has adequate evidence and revisit on a real target-specific uncertainty; this is not a compulsory platform survey or a new workflow stage.


## Target-specific checks
Relevant system appearance changes can affect contrast, images, custom surfaces
and system bars; theme is more than a skin swap. Verify actual hit regions and
meaningful accessible names, roles and focus order for custom controls, rather
than assuming a component library's defaults prove the resulting interface.
iOS modality, navigation and system text; Android custom Back, resizing and
protected capabilities; and web URL/history, browser permissions and applicable
accessibility criteria are concrete triggers for focused target guidance.
A simulator/emulator can answer some implementation questions; hardware,
physical interaction and real external context can still require devices.
Neither mandatory hardware for every layout question nor browser-as-native
proof follows. Exact platform numbers and API/component forms stay versioned
reference material, not cross-platform constants.

## Shared intent and implementation context
Share the semantic contract where it actually matches, then retain legitimate
platform differences in controls, units, typography, accessibility preferences,
navigation and presentation. Neither a lowest-common-denominator wrapper nor
pixel parity is a necessary goal. A current visual SDK style does not itself
choose the minimum supported OS. Keep compiler/SDK/library, deployment target,
tested runtime and device conditions distinguishable. A canvas unit convention
is not a physical-unit equivalence. Do not force the newest appearance or shared
UI framework; inspect the existing target and accepted intent.

records.title: Distinguish human progress, outcomes and product interactions
records.body:
# Distinguish human progress, outcomes and product interactions

## Meaning
JTBD names a family of approaches. Progress/switching traditions emphasize a person's change in circumstances; ODI emphasizes a functional process and criteria of successful execution. Do not silently treat their definitions as interchangeable. Fab's progress-oriented Human Job policy is a selected modeling lens, not a universal theoretical definition.
Within that lens, distinguish desired change from its success criteria, pain, a system-bounded use case, capability, feature, rule and state. A business outcome can be a separate reason for a requirement; do not invent a human job to legitimize it. A When/I want/so I can sentence does not establish entity type. Job Stories are contextual design representations and can legitimately describe product interactions without becoming core Human Jobs.
## Applicability and exceptions
Use these distinctions where confusing entities would change a product decision. A solution-independent formulation can expose alternatives, but deleting a product name does not establish meaningful progress. Emotional/social meaning may matter; do not fabricate an emotional ending or require separate emotional jobs. Four Forces describes switching episodes, not mandatory fields for every need. Keep the chosen lens explicit when comparing models; no compulsory JTBD stage or record schema follows.
## Evidence boundary
This is qualified synthesis of the preserved comparison. R009 mixes concepts with historical Fab application proposals; only conceptual distinctions are adopted here. Existing Human Jobs policy owns workflow behavior. The migration does not freshly verify primary citations or prove the selected ontology universally effective.

## Comparing lenses without flattening them
Christensen's synthesis emphasizes progress in circumstances, with functional,
social and emotional dimensions together. Moesta/Spiek focuses on concrete
switching timelines and forces. Klement distinguishes preferred life-situation
change from task analysis and resists treating functional/emotional/social
as universal separate job types. ODI separates a stable core functional process,
solution-independent job-map steps and desired-outcome metrics; related and
consumption-chain jobs have specific roles within that framework.
In the preserved dated comparison, Zamesin's earlier chapter stresses context,
result and emotional change; the later chapter uses job across much wider task
scales. Keep those versioned positions distinct rather than silently attributing
one stable definition to the author. Their current wording was not reverified
by this migration. Consumption-chain work can validly depend on a product:
setup, maintenance or disposal are not invalid merely because they fail Fab's
core Human Job test. Big Hire/Little Hire means acquisition versus subsequent
use in the cited Moesta account, not large versus small jobs.
Pain may be friction in a current solution or an unsatisfactory situation with
no prior product. It is neither automatically a job nor necessarily a product
defect. Need is also overloaded: an underlying motivation and an ODI success
criterion should not be silently merged. Context is causal only to the extent
it explains a relevant decision; demographics alone do not establish causality.

records.title: Keep job hypotheses distinct from behavioral evidence
records.body:
# Keep job hypotheses distinct from behavioral evidence

## Meaning
Keep observations, reported episodes, documentary constraints, researcher interpretations, assumptions and accepted product decisions distinguishable. A plausible candidate job is not discovered demand. Rewriting a feature list into Job Stories is grammatical transformation, not research. Reconstruct concrete situations, triggers, existing behavior, alternatives (including workarounds or doing nothing), decisions and results where applicable; retain contradictory evidence rather than smoothing it away.
## Applicability and exceptions
Ideas and reverse inference from requirements can generate useful hypotheses if their status stays explicit. Personal experience can support that person's situation without establishing prevalence, importance, willingness to pay or a market segment. Logs show behavior more readily than motivation; retrospective interviews rely on memory; switching interviews principally examine change; observation and diaries answer other questions. Select evidence for the consequential uncertainty, not a fixed interview quota or mandatory discovery sequence. Preserve actual requirement provenance when its human rationale is unknown.
## Evidence boundary
The source synthesizes methodological advice, not a controlled validation of Fab. A fluent statement or heuristic quality score is not evidence of truth; unsupported numerical confidence is not statistical certainty. No universal sample size, population inference from one episode or causal product-effect claim follows.

## Retaining the claim boundary
Keep the original feature or contractual requirement intact when inferring a
possible rationale; the new interpretation does not replace its provenance.
Record enough source identity, episode/context, interpretation and open questions
to revisit the claim in the existing project artifact. No special record format
is implied. Personal diary notes, real workarounds and contemporaneous records
can reduce hindsight distortion. Agreement from one or many AI analyses adds
no human participant or observed event. Market prevalence, importance, willingness
to pay and repeatable economics are separate claims requiring suitable evidence.
Feature-demo-induced agreement, no recalled episode, identical words hiding
different preferred states, or interviews yielding incompatible causal patterns
are reasons to challenge the interpretation, not proof of a new job.

records.title: Separate independent progress from steps and recovery branches
records.body:
# Separate independent progress from steps and recovery branches

## Meaning
Choose granularity for the decision and the selected JTBD lens. Different triggers, preferred results, alternatives, independent decisions, success criteria or actors can support separate jobs; no one signal proves independence. Context variants can share one progress pattern. A subordinate step loses its reason when the higher-level progress disappears; a related job may occur alongside it without being a process step.
## Applicability and exceptions
Error, forgetting, cancellation, return, changed intention and correction of the past are not automatically separate jobs. They may be an original-job context, a scenario branch, a domain rule/state or independent progress with its own trigger and alternatives. Distinguish buying a solution from repeatedly choosing to use it where their barriers differ. Neither a shared screen/topic nor a different actor alone settles the split. Do not force a fixed count, one job per feature or a flat list across abstraction levels.
## Evidence boundary
These are qualitative diagnostic distinctions from the preserved synthesis, not a mathematical classifier. Splits remain hypotheses when episodes are missing. Use the existing coverage meaning for decision-relative sufficiency and the existing slice meaning for useful implementation boundaries; this unit does not define a new product process.

## Sufficiency without a story quota
Review the relevant causal contexts, current alternatives, meaningful actors,
success criteria, hierarchy, contradictions and consequential unknowns for the
decision. Job-map functional coverage and repeated switching patterns answer
different completeness questions. A numerical story-quality rubric can support
triage but cannot establish existence, truth or a mandatory acceptance threshold.
Hypotheses can support a risk-appropriate next decision if their status and
remaining uncertainty are visible; definitive proof of every job is not required.

records.title: Choose a useful level of human progress
records.body:
# Choose a useful level of human progress

## Meaning
A useful progress boundary is neither an unbounded aspiration nor a renamed interface operation. Compare plausible higher-order progress, core episode, subordinate step and product task when the boundary is unclear. Ask what changes from A to B, why it matters, what triggers it before product use, what counts as done in that episode, and how materially different means could achieve it. Moving upward with why and downward with how helps locate a useful boundary; choosing the middle sentence by appearance does not.
## Applicability and exceptions
Solution deletion, alternative means, independent value, outcome separation and system-boundary tests are diagnostics, not individually conclusive classifiers. A broad aspiration can remain valid strategic context while needing a bounded episode for a product decision. A legitimate consumption-chain task or granular design story need not pass the stricter core Human Job test. Rewording Export as export does not turn an operation into human progress. A medically themed example in the source illustrates abstraction, not medical guidance.
## Evidence boundary
The source offers qualitative reasoning techniques and worked illustrations, not calibrated scores or a natural universal job hierarchy. State uncertain interpretations and preserve competing explanations. Same activity can serve different progress in different circumstances; concrete wording alone cannot settle the job.

records.title: Match job evidence collection to the uncertainty
records.body:
# Match job evidence collection to the uncertainty

## Meaning
Select evidence by the unanswered claim. A switch/timeline interview reconstructs a real decision: first thought, passive/active search, events, alternatives, choice, use and remaining struggle. Include failed or abandoned switches when the question concerns barriers, rather than studying only successful purchasers. Observation/contextual inquiry can reveal actual work and workarounds; diaries can capture recurring or distributed situations; artifacts can retain traces of tools and choices. Quantitative work can examine prevalence or importance once the object is meaningful, but cannot repair a poorly identified job simply by increasing sample size.
## Applicability and exceptions
Retrospective interviews can distort memory and favor change episodes. Observation may miss rare or long-running events. Diaries carry burden and self-report effects. Artifacts and logs often reveal what happened without why. Compare reported motivation with behavior instead of assuming either source is complete. Recent-switcher windows and interview-count suggestions in the packet are practitioner heuristics, not universal thresholds. Determine sufficiency from scope, heterogeneity, decision risk and the claim (existence, causal explanation, segment or prevalence). Do not require interviews for every partial task or deny a legitimate personal-use n=1 claim.
## Evidence boundary
The preserved source supplies a method-selection synthesis; its bibliography is a provenance lead, not fresh validation. A plan, synthetic respondent or model agreement is not collected human evidence. An interview supports a reported episode and interpretation, not automatically causal effectiveness, market size or willingness to pay.

records.title: Explain choice through alternatives and switching forces
records.body:
# Explain choice through alternatives and switching forces

## Meaning
Competition for progress can include another product category, manual work, help from others, existing habits or doing nothing. Begin from the relevant person's actual situation and considered behavior rather than limiting the set to products resembling the proposed feature. In the switching lens, push is pressure from the current situation, pull is attraction to a new possibility, anxiety is concern about the new, and habit/inertia retains the old. Their interaction can explain why apparent dissatisfaction does not lead to adoption.
## Applicability and exceptions
Use forces when acquisition, replacement, repeated choice or abandonment matters. They are not mandatory sentence fields for every job. A feared loss is not automatically an independent job; it can be anxiety or a success criterion. Acquisition and later use can face different barriers. Distinguish observed alternatives from proposed ones and hypotheses about their attractiveness. No existing alternative may mean missing evidence rather than an inherently novel job; non-consumption can be an intentional choice.
## Evidence boundary
These are explanatory lenses derived from the preserved comparison, not a quantitative prediction of switching or proof that a proposed solution wins. Source examples illustrate broad competition; they do not establish demand in the current project.

records.title: Use Job Stories as contextual views with preserved meaning
records.body:
# Use Job Stories as contextual views with preserved meaning

## Meaning
A Job Story is a design representation of context, motivation and intended change, not the complete research model. When should explain the relevant circumstance; I want should identify the intended result at the selected level; so I can should explain why it matters rather than repeat the result or invent an emotion. Preserve the underlying evidence, alternatives, outcomes, contradictions and hierarchy outside the sentence where they affect the decision. Different contextual stories can represent one job; a sentence template does not determine its entity type.
## Applicability and exceptions
In the cited historical practice, granular Job Stories can legitimately concern product interactions. Fab's selected Human Jobs policy deliberately uses a stricter solution-independent derived view; follow that policy for its HJ/JS artifacts without claiming it is the universal definition of all Job Stories. A product interaction is not automatically a core Human Job. User Stories serve delivery conversation and confirmation; neither story form replaces source evidence or a complete behavior model. No required story count, field schema or additional stage follows.
## Evidence boundary
The source's scoring rubric is uncalibrated triage advice. A well-formed sentence can still be invented. Context, causal unity and abstraction checks guide review, not proof of truth or automatic promotion of a candidate to validated demand.

records.title: Keep rationale traceable as evidence and decisions change
records.body:
# Keep rationale traceable as evidence and decisions change

## Meaning
Distinguish why a decision exists from what implements it. Jobs, context, outcomes, contracts, regulation and business expectations can support different parts of a product model. A revenue/churn goal and a person's progress are different axes; the claim that improving the latter changes the former is a product hypothesis. In a multi-party setting, identify the actual person, role, decision and progress rather than treating an organization as one mind.
When rationale changes, review the affected dependents: changed progress can affect its stories/use cases/capabilities; changed context affects the applicable variants; changed outcome affects criteria; a new alternative challenges competitiveness assumptions. A refuted sole rationale requires reconsidering dependent decisions. A changed feature or implementation need not rewrite the job; changed rules/contracts can affect behavior without changing human progress.
## Applicability and exceptions
Use existing project links and accepted artifacts, not a new mandatory graph or pipeline. A feature can have multiple independent reasons. Unknown human rationale does not authorize deleting a contractual requirement or fabricating evidence. Traceability supports review; it does not automatically reverse accepted scope or grant change authority. A fixed specification may permit only hypothesis annotation. Human-owned value/domain/authority choices remain with their actual owner; routine authorized analysis does not require a new ceremony.
## Evidence boundary
Reusable distinctions are extracted from source sections that also contain historical local workflow proposals. Their stages, approval rules, record formats and delegation plans are not adopted. The source's unsubstantiated B2B motivation percentage is not an empirical general rule. Traceability and consistency are not proof of user value or business viability.

## Learning without automatic intent drift
Evidence from use, review or checks can justify revisiting rationale and affected
outputs. Generated artifact volume or an agent suggestion is not itself an
accepted requirement. Preserve the difference between proposed improvement,
authorized decision and observed outcome when updating execution context.

records.title: Treat permission as a contextual capability branch
records.body:
# Treat permission as a contextual capability branch

## Meaning
Connect a permission request to the capability the person is trying to use and its understandable value. Explanation, app-level preference, account entitlement and OS/browser permission are distinct. The platform or user agent owns the actual request and permission state; drawing a prompt or enabling an in-app switch does not grant system access.
## Applicability and exceptions
Denial, revocation or unavailable access should preserve relevant work and explain the affected function. Keep unrelated functioning areas available where possible; a genuinely indispensable capability can block the dependent result. A claimed alternative must actually support the promised outcome. Permission is not automatically a first-launch slide, and a contextual request is not permission to badger the person or imply the system prompt is freely customizable. Re-evaluate effective access when returning if state may have changed.
## Evidence boundary
This is scenario-level synthesis. Exact permission scopes, repeated-prompt behavior, OS versions and browser UI need current applicable primary guidance and target evidence. A browser simulation can assess explanatory wording without proving a native denial/revocation lifecycle. No universal fallback, permission order or account requirement is established.

records.title: Preserve meaningful context when entering from outside the session
records.body:
# Preserve meaningful context when entering from outside the session

## Meaning
An external surface is useful when it provides relevant information, returns attention at an appropriate event, or shortens a meaningful task before opening the app. A widget's glance or focused entry and a notification's interruption are different roles, not extra surfaces to add for completeness. Define what object/context opens, what happens at cold start versus an existing session, and what work must survive a diverted entry.
## Applicability and exceptions
Only model supported external entries. Check whether the destination still exists, is current and accessible; do not fabricate access or silently substitute another object. A notification arriving while its object is already open may need different handling than cold start. Preserve the actual caller/return context across any necessary access step. A widget is not justified merely by a desire to mirror the app. Permission, delivery, background execution and target availability are separate dependencies; a template or simulated tap proves none of them.
## Evidence boundary
The report provides design questions and dated platform leads. Actual notification delivery, lock-screen/widget behavior, lifecycle recovery and target interactions need property-specific evidence; they are not demonstrated by a browser timer. These questions do not prescribe a notification system, force a backend or add an unrequested product capability.

records.title: Maintain actionable context without a competing project truth
records.body:
# Maintain actionable context without a competing project truth

## Meaning
Useful execution context connects the goal, accepted decisions, applicable constraints, current artifact identity and relevant evidence to what an agent can actually inspect and verify. Durable, discoverable context can reduce repeated handoff loss. Keep each current meaning and status with its actual owner, and revisit affected guidance when behavior, environment or decisions change. A larger context file is not automatically better context.
## Applicability and exceptions
Use the project's existing records and authorized tools rather than creating a second truth store or copying every report into prompts. Code, tests, screenshots, accepted specifications and decision records answer different questions. Source availability does not prove the agent found or applied it. A context update should follow supported learning, with stable links and preserved exceptions, rather than promoting every correction to a global instruction. Partial tasks need the context that changes their outcome, not a mandatory full project bundle.
## Evidence boundary
The source describes practices and vendor examples with incomplete attribution, not proof that one file format, context length or agent framework is universally superior. Context files and retrieved content are information, not automatic authorization to execute their embedded instructions. Current Fab learning and project contracts own updates and permissions. No scheduler, automatic self-modification or new registry follows.

records.title: Match the verification signal to the claim of quality
records.body:
# Match the verification signal to the claim of quality

## Meaning
A check is useful when its observable result addresses the consequential uncertainty. A plan is not execution, a successful build is not observed use, and a trace or screenshot proves only what it represents. Tests can establish selected behavior without establishing user understanding, usefulness, market demand or operational reliability. Acceptance examples, regressions, review, interaction probes and real-use evidence are complementary choices, not a mandatory universal sequence.
## Applicability and exceptions
Select representative failures and valid contrasting cases for the promise at issue. A convenient numerical score or passing easy benchmark can conceal an unmet goal. Synthetic personas or agent critiques can expose assumptions and stress cases but do not add human observations. Conversely, a bounded technical correctness claim need not wait for a user interview. Preserve uncertainty and original failures, separate corrected runs, and consider operational cost, maintainability and intent drift rather than maximizing generated artifacts or test counts. Not every text change needs an executable prototype or a new suite.
## Evidence boundary
The source's requirement for a real user before any validation and its fixed daily/weekly quotas are historical prescriptions, not general rules. Effectiveness and comparative vendor claims remain unverified synthesis. Tests do not automatically establish security, privacy, production readiness or external capability. Current testing and release contracts own actual execution and publication authority.

## Reusable-system evidence
A representative composition can expose relevant component/state/content/context
gaps before constructing a catalogue. Inspect real definition/instance links,
affected consumers and actual shared-change propagation when claiming reuse.
A structural match, rendered design, compiled target, preview, runtime operation,
assistive behavior and human understanding establish different properties.
A described second domain is designed extensibility, not an executed migration
or arbitrary scale. Choose representative probes for the claim rather than
mandating every source checklist, a full platform survey or a fixed screen count.
Company benchmarks and agent discoverability ratings are reported or inferred,
not measurements of the current workflow. Preserve initial failures.

records.title: Separate automation capability from decision authority and ownership
records.body:
# Separate automation capability from decision authority and ownership

## Meaning
Automation can perform substantial analysis, construction and checking without becoming the owner of the goal or the authority for consequential choices. Keep the actual responsible person and accepted scope clear. Reversible authorized work can proceed autonomously while unresolved value judgments, changed commitments, access and consequential tradeoffs retain their real decision owner. An agent's ability to publish, delegate or change a requirement does not itself grant that authority.
## Applicability and exceptions
Scout, builder, reviewer and tester are useful modes of work, not a required roster of agents or people. Separate checks or perspectives when they answer a real uncertainty. Parallel alternatives can help exploration, but introduce coordination, context and integration costs. A single-agent approach can be sufficient. Task complexity or a source recommendation does not override the user's permission boundary for delegation, new chats, external actions or release. Do not turn human accountability into an approval gate for every routine edit, or infer indefinite authority from a completed earlier approval.
## Evidence boundary
The source's role charts, branch counts, meeting schedules and agentic operating models are proposals and dated vendor accounts. They do not establish universal staffing, productivity superiority or a mandate to orchestrate agents. Actual project/host instructions govern actions. This knowledge describes distinctions, not a new approval or automation system.

records.title: Choose artifacts and tools for the decision they make inspectable
records.body:
# Choose artifacts and tools for the decision they make inspectable

## Meaning
Preserve the useful function of an artifact rather than assuming its name or format establishes progress. A runnable slice can make selected behavior inspectable sooner. A concise specification, diagram or research synthesis can be the right artifact for a different uncertainty. Neither documents nor code are inherently the sole truth of intent, behavior, evidence and authority. Connect the relevant artifacts and keep accepted obligations visible.
## Applicability and exceptions
Choose a tool by the needed access, execution, verification, portability and evidence properties. One environment may cover several roles. Do not assemble every tool class, replace an existing backlog, or generate a PRD, prototype and scorecard merely to satisfy a catalogue. A prompt-built demo may be useful while leaving persistence, error behavior, accessibility, integration and production hardening unproved. Code export alone does not establish maintainability or independence from proprietary services. Complexity and exit costs matter alongside generation speed.
## Evidence boundary
The preserved comparison of classic, lean, no-code, AI-assisted and agentic workflows is author synthesis, not a controlled benchmark or proof that older practices are obsolete. Historical replacement tables, fixed stages and 30-day plans are optional illustrations, not Fab's required pipeline. Platform/tool capabilities and version-specific claims must be checked when the current decision depends on them.

records.title: Distinguish first useful value from setup, demonstration and later outcomes
records.body:
# Distinguish first useful value from setup, demonstration and later outcomes

## Meaning
Product explanation, interface learning, setup, identity, permission, activation and useful outcome serve different purposes. Completion of one does not establish the others. Define the earliest observable result that meaningfully advances the selected person's progress in the actual role and situation. The source calls this First Value Event, an author-defined synthesis rather than a universal industry standard. Do not label a click, empty project, import completion or permission grant as value without its result.
## Applicability and exceptions
Immediate value can arise in one operation. Accumulating value may require repetition, time, data or other people. Distinguish first useful outcome, evidence of recurring value and mature outcome. Label demonstrations, proxies and achieved results honestly. Sample data can help understand a mechanism without proving a result on the person's own data. A demo can itself serve an evaluation job, so it is not inherently valueless. Explain why progress matters in the person's world without promising an unsupported lasting effect or inventing an emotion.
## Evidence boundary
Onboarding completion and early activation do not prove comprehension, retention or causal benefit. The local terminology and example event definitions are decision aids, not required new metrics or a separate stage. Existing accepted success criteria can serve the purpose. Current artifact observation, real behavior and a relevant claim-specific test are different evidence from a polished explanation.

records.title: Choose entry paths from real intent and necessary prerequisites
records.body:
# Choose entry paths from real intent and necessary prerequisites

## Meaning
Entry source can already carry intent, object, role, data or host context. New to the product does not mean new to the domain or tool category. Determine which differences actually change the path, not a compulsory profile form. Ask what fails if each pre-result step is removed or deferred. Correctness, actual access, safety, informed understanding, necessary data and entitlement can be genuine dependencies. Optimization, preference or future marketing utility alone do not establish necessity now.
## Applicability and exceptions
An invitee need not perform the owner's workspace setup. Do not ask for a role already determined reliably by the invitation or access model. Identity, profile enrichment, data input, permission, entitlement and synchronization are distinct dependencies. A local useful task may work without an account or network, while a genuinely remote or access-controlled result can require them. Minimum personalization data depends on the real model. Necessary safeguards must not be removed solely to shorten time to value. Explanation before a risky action may be essential.
Preserve the supported target and unfinished work through required interruptions. After skip, denial, expiry or later return, resume what remains relevant rather than blindly replaying first-run screens. A real unmet prerequisite can leave the result unavailable. Never invent a successful fallback. Optional setup should have a meaningful later entry instead of repeated prompting on every launch.
## Evidence boundary
The source suggests a dependency graph as a reasoning aid, not mandatory metadata or a new onboarding specification. Actual legal, platform, access and persistence requirements need current applicable evidence when they affect the decision. No universal registration ban, permission timing, paywall order or threshold for the number of steps follows.

records.title: Choose explanation and guidance at the moment they help
records.body:
# Choose explanation and guidance at the moment they help

## Meaning
Compare direct work, brief explanation, guided real task, contextual help, sample data, necessary setup and progressive disclosure by what the person needs to understand or do. Direct entry is worth considering when intent and action are clear, but shortest is not automatically safest or sufficient. Before action explain information needed for an informed choice. During action support current input and state. After action expose the actual result and its status before covering it with another recommendation.
## Applicability and exceptions
Separate introductory explanation is useful when an important model, consequence or limitation must be understood before action and cannot reasonably be learned in context. Familiarity or novelty alone does not justify a tour. Guided work should match the actual task, contextual help should appear before it is too late, and help can remain available on demand after skip. Progressive disclosure can reduce initial complexity but can also hide a needed function. Use real domain and category experience rather than treating every newcomer identically. A utility with already-known intent need not become an internal landing page.
## Evidence boundary
The source reports mixed outcomes in specific visualization and cryptocurrency-app studies and varied newcomer help behavior. These do not establish universal retention gains, a required slide count or the superiority of one pattern. Value explanation, mechanism demonstration and setup should be evaluated against their different purposes. A comprehension test is not proof of lasting product benefit.

records.title: Connect goals to signals without confusing association and causality
records.body:
# Connect goals to signals without confusing association and causality

## Meaning
Start with the desired outcome, the observable signal that would indicate it, then a metric whose definition preserves that meaning. Define eligible population, event semantics, success/failure and observation interval. For time to first value, choose the relevant entry origin. Separate elapsed waiting from active effort, result quality from completion, dependency losses from recovery, and early value from later return. Incompatible roles, intentions or entry channels need not share one denominator.
## Applicability and exceptions
An activation event is a hypothesis about useful behavior, not a magic causal milestone. First ask whether the event actually represents the intended value, then whether its association with later outcomes survives relevant alternative explanations. More motivated users may both activate and return. If a causal claim matters, use an appropriate design and check instrumentation, power, carry-over and outcome selection. Forcing an event can change its meaning. A randomized variant improving both an early event and retention establishes an effect of the variant, not automatically mediation by the event itself.
Metrics should serve the decision. No universal seconds, steps, participants or conversion benchmark follows. A bounded reversible interaction question may need different evidence from a high-risk or lasting-effect claim.
## Evidence boundary
This is qualified methodological synthesis, not a statistical analysis of the current product or proof that a particular first event causes retention. Source studies have context and outcome limits. A prototype can support selected path/comprehension evidence when observed with people, but cannot alone establish long-term behavior, real permission/storage behavior or commercial viability.

## Paid-value and economics guardrails
Distinguish eligible offer exposure, intent/trial start, confirmed payment,
first paid result, meaningful continuing use and renewal/repeat purchase.
Separate voluntary departure from payment-related loss of access. Revenue
without refunds, provider/platform costs, variable service cost and support can
hide a worse outcome. Track relevant cancellation, entitlement or data-loss
incidents alongside the local funnel.
Concept/usability work can inform understanding, a transparent intent probe
can inform interest, and a real paid pilot can provide stronger willingness-to-pay
evidence. None alone establishes repeatable conversion or viability. A small
audience may not support an informative randomized comparison. Benchmark and
cohort associations remain context, not causal recipes. Higher conversion can
coexist with lower paid value, worse retention, refunds, support cost or trust.

records.title: Choose a revenue mechanism from value and service economics
records.body:
# Choose a revenue mechanism from value and service economics

## Meaning
A revenue mechanism is a hypothesis about value, payer and sustainable obligations. Consider value recurrence and rhythm, variable consumption costs, ongoing service/support obligations, segment and real alternatives. Usage frequency alone does not determine a subscription. Rarely used readiness can be continuing value, while frequent local use need not imply continuing service.
SaaS describes delivery, not a pricing mechanism. Freemium describes a durable free/paid boundary that can sit over one-off, recurring, usage or hybrid pricing. Credits account for usage rather than creating a new economic model.
## Applicability and exceptions
Free can be a deliberate result when direct user revenue is not the aim. A one-off purchase can suit a bounded asset with limited future obligations. Continuing service can support recurring pricing, consumption-linked value/cost can support usage pricing, and two material independent drivers can support a hybrid. These are candidates, not a rule that every product needs tiers, freemium or a subscription. Indefinite service costs can make a lifetime promise risky. Credits should help predict spend rather than hide the action-to-price relation.
## Evidence boundary
Economic theories and source comparisons do not yield an optimal actual price or prove willingness to pay. Revisit changed payer, segment, value, alternative, cost or obligation. A commercial path is relevant only when the actual creator/product intent calls for it. No automatically mandated pricing research, tariff count or financial forecast follows.

records.title: Make the paid boundary explainable and preserve a coherent user result
records.body:
# Make the paid boundary explainable and preserve a coherent user result

## Meaning
Identify the paid unit and the paying actor, who may differ from the person using the result. Access, volume, capability, content and service measure different value/cost relationships. Explain what additional or continuing result is purchased, why the segment values it, and whether usage and effective access can be determined reliably.
## Applicability and exceptions
Where a free scenario is offered as useful, it should deliver its stated coherent result rather than reveal a surprise blocker at the only useful save/export step. A clearly disclosed paid-only task is not the same as an unexpectedly broken free promise. Predictable limits can reflect real usage or cost, but arbitrary feature damage is not justified merely by naming premium. Explain consequences before commitment and define what remains readable, editable, exportable or stored after refusal and downgrade. Neither automatic data destruction nor unlimited free retention is a universal default.
## Evidence boundary
A plausible segment, versioning theory or polished paywall does not prove willingness to pay or market fit. Manipulation can increase conversion without increasing informed value. Legal treatment depends on applicable context and is not determined by this knowledge. Accepted domain, access and retention rules retain their actual owner.

records.title: Design trial access around the uncertainty it can reduce
records.body:
# Design trial access around the uncertainty it can reduce
