## Meaning
A trial is one way to let a person assess paid value, not a required stage. Compare a sample/demo, time allowance, usage allowance, premium-feature access, durable free core or fully paid entry according to the unresolved question and the actual value cycle. Define what is temporary or consumed, when access begins, what can be learned and what happens at expiry.
## Applicability and exceptions
Starting a clock when meaningful evaluation becomes possible can avoid spending it on import or waiting, but real service costs may begin immediately and justify another contract. Usage allowances can create pressure to conserve rather than evaluate normally. Cardless and auto-converting trials impose different commitments. Make the trial duration, later price, renewal behavior, cancellation and remaining rights understandable before consent. A durable free tier does not establish premium value. Expiry must account for data, unfinished work, cost, later reactivation and the returning view.
## Evidence boundary
A source trial-duration experiment has product-specific and funnel-specific results, not a universal optimal number. Technical provider examples show possibilities, not conversion superiority. A trial signup, evaluation-intent click or usability test is not a paid purchase or scalable demand. Current provider, platform and legal details require appropriate fresh evidence.

records.title: Place and repeat offers according to intent and available value evidence
records.body:
# Place and repeat offers according to intent and available value evidence

## Meaning
An offer can be appropriate at deliberate paid entry, after useful experience, on a requested premium action or at a meaningful usage limit. The relevant question is what the person already understands and what evidence of paid value is available. Initial onboarding and an offer are different roles even when they share a path.
## Applicability and exceptions
A fully paid product can legitimately offer purchase before an in-app result when outside context supports informed intent. Other products need real use first. No universal first-screen, post-value or trial-before-pay order follows. Refusal should return to the actual task with agreed work preserved. A renewed premium request, changed limit or trial expiry may justify another offer. An arbitrary launch count alone does not establish a universally appropriate repetition schedule. Explain the actual charge, period/volume, renewal and access consequences without hidden components, false urgency or obscured refusal.
## Evidence boundary
Clarity and informed choice are product judgments, not a substitute for jurisdiction-specific compliance. A prototype can assess understanding only through actual appropriate observation. Intent clicks, local conversion and benchmark practices do not establish paid demand, causal lifetime value or an optimum offer cadence.

records.title: Separate the payment attempt from effective access and retained work
records.body:
# Separate the payment attempt from effective access and retained work

## Meaning
A transaction answers what happened to a particular payment attempt. Entitlement answers what the person can do now, under which source/plan/period/usage and verification state. Keep those axes distinct. Initiated, provider-pending, confirmed failure and unknown result differ. Reconcile the original attempt through the trusted source before proposing a potentially duplicate purchase. A timer or checkout dismissal does not establish the result.
## Applicability and exceptions
Map only applicable lifecycle properties: confirmed access, cancellation of future renewal, period expiry, grace/recovery, hold, refund/revocation, immediate or scheduled plan change, restore, another device and resubscription. Renewal disabled need not mean current access expired. Refund requested need not mean access revoked. A scheduled plan change need not immediately replace current rights. Provider rules decide the actual transition, not this generic example.
Define reading, editing, export, retained data and pending work after access changes. Ending entitlement and deleting data are separate events. Restore requires a trusted ownership/access relation, not merely remembering a success screen or inventing an account. Independently committed work does not vanish just because an offer closes. Avoid one screen per combination or a single premium boolean when material dimensions differ.
## Evidence boundary
The source state map and field list are illustrative, not a universal API/schema or transaction guarantee. Actual verification, synchronization, provider updates and cross-device identity need implementation evidence. Generic operation knowledge cannot establish safe payment retries, refund law or current storefront behavior.

records.title: Keep external rules scoped, dated and separate from stable product reasoning
records.body:
# Keep external rules scoped, dated and separate from stable product reasoning

## Meaning
Stable questions about value and access do not freeze external billing, platform or legal rules. Keep the rule's actual source, date, target version, jurisdiction/storefront, product category and applicability distinguishable. Current, announced, not-yet-effective, superseded and unknown are different statuses. A single compliance boolean or undated universal payment route can conceal those differences.
## Applicability and exceptions
When a consequential decision depends on an external rule, check the actual current primary source and scope. A new channel, region, processor, billing/API version, trial/renewal/cancellation contract, sensitive audience, court/policy change or approaching submission can trigger revalidation. A fixed arbitrary review interval is not sufficient proof of freshness. Storefront control and a web processor's configuration differ. A rule for online platforms, B2C or one region need not apply to every standalone tool or B2B flow.
Keep helpful product clarity separate from a legal compliance conclusion. No automatic full legal review is required for an unrelated task, but historical legal examples cannot authorize an actual launch or become permanent policy.
## Evidence boundary
The packet's country rules and dates are historical source assertions, not reverified current guidance. Four EUR-Lex export bindings remain unresolved. This meaning preserves update and applicability reasoning without declaring which law or program presently applies. Platform and legal implementation conclusions require their own competent evidence.

records.title: Check whether willingness is the obstacle before adding game elements
records.body:
# Check whether willingness is the obstacle before adding game elements

## Meaning
Game thinking can ask why a person would willingly perform a valuable activity, understand its consequences and continue. The participant's immediate purpose and the creator's outcome can differ. Explain the connection rather than assuming that more activity benefits both. First distinguish willingness from missing skill, access, affordability, useful functionality or clear interaction.
## Applicability and exceptions
Meaningful choices, observable actions and feedback can make motivational design relevant. They do not by themselves establish benefit. Examine existing incentives and product promises. Extra play can conflict with a promise to save time, and competition can damage cooperation. A useful experience may need no reward layer. Internal employee programs, customer experiences and behavior-change contexts differ. Game thinking does not require a complete game world and is not mathematical game theory.
The book's 6D questions connect outcomes, behavior, participant differences, activity cycles, voluntary interest and suitable tools. They are reasoning aids, not six mandatory documents or stages.
## Evidence boundary
This is selective attributed synthesis from Werbach/Hunter's For the Win, not the full book, a new empirical review or evidence that gamification works in the current product. Real ability/access problems are not cured by adding motivation. Existing goals, authority and behavior contracts govern any actual intervention.

records.title: Treat rewards and psychological needs as contextual explanations
records.body:
# Treat rewards and psychological needs as contextual explanations

## Meaning
In the book's account, competence, autonomy and relatedness help explain an experience, not specify three required widgets. Feedback can support understanding and a suitable challenge, meaningful choice can support agency, and recognition/support can matter without a public contest. A score does not prove ability and a cosmetic choice does not establish control over participation.
Intrinsic motivation concerns the activity itself. Extrinsic motivation concerns a separable result, which can still be personally meaningful. The same reward can be interpreted differently by different people and at different times.
## Applicability and exceptions
Expected contingent rewards can redirect attention toward earning the reward, while external recognition can support some routine activities. Neither implies all rewards help or all rewards harm. Ask whether feedback communicates understanding or pressure. Necessary purposeful routine need not be intrinsically enjoyable to be worthwhile. Bartle's historical player categories can prompt questions about motives but are not universal personality diagnoses, permanent personas or proof of a preferred competition style.
## Evidence boundary
The source is the book-derived selective synthesis with selected passage checks, not independent verification of self-determination theory or effect sizes. Specific populations, lasting motivation, learning and wellbeing require applicable evidence beyond this material. A plausible motivational explanation stays a hypothesis until supported.

records.title: Choose the function of feedback and comparison before its visible component
records.body:
# Choose the function of feedback and comparison before its visible component

## Meaning
Experience dynamics, interaction mechanics and concrete components are different levels with many-to-many relationships. A quest can implement challenge and feedback in support of progression, but copying the component does not recreate the experience. Select the purpose before choosing points, badges, levels, teams or a leaderboard.
Points can express score, exchange, status, feedback or internal analytics. Internal measurement need not become a visible currency. Badges can communicate a possible goal, reputation or belonging, while a credible skill credential needs trustworthy criteria and issuer. Leaderboards emphasize relative standing rather than personal or collective progress.
## Applicability and exceptions
Relative competition can suit some people and contexts while discouraging others or undermining cooperation. Personal growth, contextual comparison and collective achievement are alternatives, not mandatory replacements for every ranking. A decorative award is not evidence of the skill it names. Do not implement the full element catalogue or assume one component has one psychological effect.
## Evidence boundary
The taxonomy and historical stories are book-derived design vocabulary, not causal forecasts of engagement, learning, retention or sales. Component resemblance does not prove function, comprehension or benefit. Context and actual behavior determine whether the chosen implementation serves its intended role.

records.title: Distinguish immediate feedback from longer progression and mastery
records.body:
# Distinguish immediate feedback from longer progression and mastery

## Meaning
A short engagement loop connects motivation, action and feedback. Feedback should make the result intelligible and explain why another action is meaningful for the person. Receiving a token does not explain continuation unless that token or activity matters. Longer progression asks how support, challenge and capability change with experience rather than merely increasing a counter.
## Applicability and exceptions
Accessible beginnings, later challenges and periods of ease are possibilities, not a compulsory difficulty curve or boss encounter. Newcomers and experienced people can need different support without fixed demographic labels. Decide whether a finite achievement or continuing practice serves the purpose. Winning can end participation or make others lose, and endless return is not automatically success. Meaningful routine can serve an external goal without constant entertainment.
## Evidence boundary
A short observed session can support comprehension or immediate preference, not durable motivation or changed capability. Longer behavior and appropriate comparison are needed for stronger claims. The source's application inference is not a full experimental protocol. Reuse claim-sensitive measurement instead of inventing universal retention or progression targets.

records.title: Examine what incentives make rational and who bears their consequences
records.body:
# Examine what incentives make rational and who bears their consequences

## Meaning
People respond to implemented rules and consequences. Ask what becomes advantageous to optimize and whether that damages the actual outcome, quality, collaboration, trust or the participant's purpose. Activity in a reward layer can diverge from the intended business result. Recognition and a measurable task still need relevant quality safeguards.
## Applicability and exceptions
Unexpected behavior can support the desired outcome, so do not ban every unplanned action solely because it was unplanned. Voluntariness depends on power and consequences. A workplace ranking tied to pay or employment differs from an optional challenge even when the visual design looks playful. Consider burdens introduced by a sophisticated mechanism, not just its ingenuity. Declining or completing an experience need not be a failure to maximize engagement.
## Evidence boundary
Book cases illustrate tensions and alternative explanations, not verified causal effects or current product facts. An optimistic theory is not proof of harmlessness. Specific ages, vulnerabilities, employment relationships or consequential real-world effects need their own evidence. The historical legal map is not current law, and an agreement does not settle every issue. This knowledge does not authorize tracking, experiments or new features.

records.title: Guide the intended visitor from repository purpose to useful use
records.body:
# Guide the intended visitor from repository purpose to useful use

## Meaning
A repository visitor needs to understand purpose, suitability, supported result and how to reach first useful use. Library consumers, CLI users, installed-app users, contributors and evaluators need different detail. Keep a useful example and supported start discoverable, distinguish installing the distributed product from building its source, and link deeper reference when it helps rather than duplicating it.
## Applicability and exceptions
Demonstrate the actual supported version through code, text output, screenshot, recording or interactive example according to the question. CLI screenshots are not inherently useless. Keep platform/dependency/status limits and support routes understandable. Names, descriptions, topics and preview media can help identify and find the project, but are not a substitute for useful content or proof of conversion/trust effects. A private or commercial product can direct users through an appropriate website rather than a universal public README template.
## Evidence boundary
The source's case revisions and some identities are unresolved. Four case narratives are illustrations, not reproduced benchmarks, and no plugin case was independently examined. Reconstructed bibliography does not substantiate every claim. Exact media dimensions, SEO effects and current platform capabilities require applicable evidence rather than copying dated examples.

records.title: Add repository machinery for real maintenance and participation needs
triggers: Code of Conduct для личного скрипта
records.body:
# Add repository machinery for real maintenance and participation needs

## Meaning
Organize code, examples, tests, assets and documentation around actual work and the existing project structure. Support/contribution guidance, issue/PR forms, discussion spaces, changelog, site and automation each impose maintenance costs and should solve a real problem. Contributor setup and reporting instructions can lower repeated coordination when external participation actually exists.
## Applicability and exceptions
No universal src folder, root-file count, monorepo layout, branch model or maturity checklist follows. A separate CHANGELOG can be useful for frequent or complex history, while release notes can suffice for a smaller pattern. Existing legal, community, organizational or distribution obligations can make an otherwise optional element necessary. Monorepo and separate repositories have collaboration and tooling tradeoffs rather than a size-only winner. Explain maintenance/support status, but a historical suggestion does not authorize archiving, moving or restructuring a repository.
## Evidence boundary
The source's minimum-per-maturity lists are contextual suggestions, not validated universal quotas. Adding files or badges does not establish reliability, trust or active support. Assess the actual visitor and maintainer path rather than decorating a repository to match a template.

records.title: Keep source, release, artifact and installed identities distinct
records.body:
# Keep source, release, artifact and installed identities distinct

## Meaning
A commit identifies source history. A ref or tag names a target. A Release is a publication object. A generated source snapshot, built installable artifact, distribution channel and actual installed version are distinct identities. Record the relevant correspondence rather than treating a version label as proof that the same bytes are built, published and installed.
## Applicability and exceptions
Ordinary refs/tags can move. An unchanged commit's extracted archive contents and the compressed archive's exact bytes have different stability guarantees. Do not equate source ZIP with a tested installable product. An enabled immutable GitHub Release protects its associated tag and attached assets. Its title/notes and some release labels remain editable, and deletion has separate consequences. A release existing does not establish that protection is enabled.
If a project adopts SemVer or a channel's immutable version contract, fixes use a new version rather than silently replacing the existing payload. Other version schemes are valid when their meaning is explicit. A draft can prepare assets before publication without conferring permission to publish.
## Evidence boundary
Selected GitHub primary checks were repeated2026-10-29: [source-archive stability](https://docs.github.com/en/repositories/working-with-files/using-files/downloading-source-code-archives) and [immutable-release protection](https://docs.github.com/en/code-security/concepts/supply-chain-security/immutable-releases). They qualify the preserved report's stronger claims. No signature/protection, byte identity, clean installation or operational readiness of the current project is established merely by this knowledge.

records.title: Verify the promised distribution path rather than only the build workflow
records.body:
# Verify the promised distribution path rather than only the build workflow

## Meaning
Match automation to repeatable work, release frequency, maintenance capacity and the actual promise. A passing workflow establishes only its executed checks. Building source, package contents, installation from the real channel, first operation, update/compatibility and rollback are distinct evidence. A link/snippet check can establish consistency without proving semantic usefulness. Generated notes need to communicate actual user-relevant changes.
## Applicability and exceptions
Use a clean relevant environment or otherwise bounded baseline when verifying a distribution promise. A manual bounded release can be sufficient, while repeated complex releases can justify automation. Automation reduces some repetitive mistakes but does not eliminate human error or make publication the automatic end of every merge. Verify the actual selected channel/version and affected compatibility. Respect the project's existing release authority and version contract. No universal CI stack or release frequency follows.
## Evidence boundary
The report's examples actions/create-release and actions/upload-release-asset were rechecked2026-10-29 and are archived/unmaintained: [create-release](https://github.com/actions/create-release), [upload-release-asset](https://github.com/actions/upload-release-asset). Their historical listing is not a current recommendation. No replacement tool, dependency/security audit or actual install was tested in this migration. A generic GitHub path does not establish an app-store or plugin-market route.

records.title: Distinguish visibility, ownership and distribution permission
records.body:
# Distinguish visibility, ownership and distribution permission

## Meaning
Repository visibility, actual ownership, permission to use/change/distribute and the conditions of the delivered package are different questions. Own code, dependencies, snippets, fonts, images and other media can have different sources and obligations. A license label or public repository alone does not establish that the distributor owns or can grant all required rights.
## Applicability and exceptions
For an actual licensing/distribution decision inspect the relevant texts, actual contribution/ownership facts, dependency and media use, intended channel and jurisdiction. Do not infer ownership from the person running the tool, assume one license cures third-party rights, or turn a simplified no-license sentence into a universal legal conclusion. A decision can need qualified review when applicability is material. The source's catalogue does not authorize relicensing, removing assets or changing visibility.
## Evidence boundary
The report contains categorical and incomplete licensing claims. This meaning retains useful distinctions and rejects automatic conclusions, without selecting a license, resolving compatibility, or offering current jurisdiction-specific legal advice. The restored bibliography is a lead, not claim-level legal verification.

records.title: Choose access priority from frequency, urgency, context and consequences
triggers: редкое опасное действие на главном экране
records.body:
# Choose access priority from frequency, urgency, context and consequences

## Meaning
Frequency, importance, urgency, error cost and reversibility give different reasons for access and protection. Keep observed frequency separate from an assumption. Frequent or urgent work may need direct access, object-specific work a contextual entry, infrequent work a discoverable secondary route, and costly mistakes a suitable safeguard. One priority score can conceal why these needs differ. Choose a repeat-entry candidate from the current valuable task. Overview is useful when the summary changes the next decision, not simply as an obligatory home page.
## Applicability and exceptions
Rare destructive work need not become a top-level destination because its consequences are high. Search can be a persistent place when itself a recurring independent mode, or a contextual action otherwise. More direct is not always better than a meaningful hierarchy. No universal tap/depth maximum or maximally flat root follows. Shared objects and mental models can support one structure with role-dependent capabilities. Material differences in work, objects and responsibility can justify different roots. Preserve supported external/resume entries. For web, decide what deserves URL/history, refresh and deep-link behavior rather than assuming all transient UI is addressable.
## Evidence boundary
These are contextual heuristics and qualified source findings, not measured priorities in the current product. Platform guidance describes mechanisms rather than the correct root for a domain. The source's access categories and case assumptions do not impose metadata or a fixed IA.

records.title: Match structure evaluation to grouping, findability and task uncertainty
records.body:
# Match structure evaluation to grouping, findability and task uncertainty

## Meaning
Structural consistency, explanatory rationale, diagram readability, creator judgment and user evidence answer different questions. A desk walkthrough can expose task-step assumptions. Card sorting can generate grouping hypotheses, tree testing can evaluate proposed categories and labels, and first-choice/backtracking behavior can expose findability problems. An appropriately observed clickable or paper task can examine sequence and understanding.
## Applicability and exceptions
Probe selected critical paths far enough to expose missing contexts, access, commit/result and return contradictions without designing every state. Frequent work, high-consequence actions, temporal rules and unusual entry can distinguish useful probes. A flow requiring a new surface or return meaning calls for review of the affected structure, not silent duplication. Flow and structure can refine each other rather than form a rigid one-way pipeline. Small formative rounds can help, but historical participant-count findings do not establish a universal sufficient sample. Creator approval, correct diagram syntax and an attractive map do not establish comprehension, real frequency, accessibility or technical invariants.
## Evidence boundary
Probe counts, stage approvals and required map formats are historical local proposals. Methods offer question-specific evidence, not guaranteed optimal IA or reliable agent generation. More consequential or heterogeneous decisions can need stronger appropriate evidence. Current capability contracts own actual outputs and authority.

records.title: Separate input format, domain validity, field dependencies and preserved work
records.body:
# Separate input format, domain validity, field dependencies and preserved work

## Meaning
A parseable value can still be invalid for the domain. Distinguish syntactic validity, semantic/domain acceptability, dependencies between fields and survival of already-entered work after an unsuccessful attempt, navigation or interruption. Valid start and end dates individually do not establish their valid relation. Acceptance rules should reflect the actual field and operation.
## Applicability and exceptions
Regex can help with a simple structured format. It does not prove a domain object exists, the person has access, a mailbox is owned, multiple fields agree or downstream use is safe. Browser/client constraints can provide early feedback without establishing authoritative domain or server enforcement. Rich input can need different processing. Explain the actual problematic input and error sufficiently to support correction, preserving relevant unaffected work according to the accepted contract. Check meaningful states and dependencies. Intentionally disposable input does not imply indefinite draft retention.
## Evidence boundary
This is qualified validation reasoning, not a current API, security audit, universal regex or complete accessibility conformance test. Timing, focus and representation reuse existing input/continuation meanings. Actual ownership, authorization, persistence and richer-content handling require their corresponding implementation evidence.

records.title: Reduce test space with explicit partitions, boundaries and transition risks
records.body:
# Reduce test space with explicit partitions, boundaries and transition risks

## Meaning
Select cases that distinguish behavior rather than enumerate every value. Equivalence classes suit inputs governed by the same rule. Boundaries suit ordered quantities or limits. State-transition tests suit lifecycle and allowed/forbidden moves. A decision table suits interacting conditions that jointly determine permission or result. Choose risk-sensitive representatives when failures differ in consequence and check cost.
## Applicability and exceptions
A category without meaningful order need not have boundary tests. A simple stateless utility need not have a lifecycle model. Pairwise or t-way can compress suitable relatively independent configuration factors, but cannot replace a known consequential higher-order combination or temporal sequence. Domain-valid length and layout-safe length can differ, so long-but-valid display data can merit a separate fixture. Fixtures represent data/domain state, while condition vectors represent relevant environment/responses. Combine with expected transitions rather than copying every screen. Do not combine mutually incompatible states or create every toggle by default. Preserve actual high-consequence failure/recovery cases and explain collapsed equivalents.
## Evidence boundary
These techniques are reasoning aids, not a theorem of sufficient pairwise coverage or universal fixture count/coverage percentage. Pick the cheapest adequate check for the uncertainty, not a compulsory ladder to production. Risk scoring, matrices and fixture schemas remain optional formats under existing testing contracts.

records.title: Distinguish exact timing, eventual completion and resumable work
records.body:
# Distinguish exact timing, eventual completion and resumable work

## Meaning
A request to complete eventually, promptly, exactly at a specified moment or after a UI closes expresses different promises. Choose the actual timing/lifecycle requirement before a scheduler or notification API. Triggering, permission, scheduling, delivery, tap destination and cancellation are different parts of the path. A running foreground timer does not establish any background delivery guarantee.
## Applicability and exceptions
Local reminders and remotely originated notifications can have different infrastructure requirements. The word notification does not automatically imply a backend. A widget can have its own state source, permitted staleness and refresh lifecycle rather than mirror the main session continuously. Determine whether freshness, an action or exact timing is material, and whether system/network/power constraints can change the promise. Do not invent a fixed refresh interval, permanent background process or universally exact schedule.
## Evidence boundary
The source's OS/API versions are dated reference, not present capability guarantees. Documentation and a bounded real-target probe can answer the dependent property when needed. A layout-only explanation can be reviewed without such a probe. This meaning does not add a scheduler, device test or new capability to an unrelated task.

records.title: Make interface wording identify the actual task, object and known result
records.body:
# Make interface wording identify the actual task, object and known result

## Meaning
Use wording to make the current object, purpose, action and known result understandable. Choose a heading, label, paragraph, list or parallel-value table for the information relationship, not to fill a layout template. Context and text can work together, but an ambiguous operation should not rely on visual position alone. Error feedback should help identify what went wrong and how to proceed when those facts are actually known.
## Applicability and exceptions
A concise action can be clear when its object is already unambiguous. A secondary heading can add distinct context or merely repeat another label. Remove redundancy by its informational role, not a ban on all secondary headings. An obvious visual control can still need appropriate accessible meaning, without requiring a visible sentence on every icon. Do not invent a cause, validation rule or recovery instruction to avoid generic text. Preserve actual domain terms, technical identifiers and accepted wording when they serve the reader's task. Public promotional content and working-tool interaction can need different language.
## Evidence boundary
The source's examples are contextual editorial guidance, not a universal copy formula or comprehension proof. A source example about password length is not a real requirement for another form. Static text checks can flag patterns, while understanding needs suitable observation. Current interface and scenario policies own actual authoring.

records.title: Apply Russian typography without corrupting literal content or adaptation
records.body:
# Apply Russian typography without corrupting literal content or adaptation

## Meaning
Check real Cyrillic and mixed-script text, punctuation, numeric ranges, units and localized content with a suitable actual font. Distinguish quotation marks, hyphen, range dash and sentence dash by their role. Keep short semantically bound number/unit groups together where appropriate, while checking resulting width behavior. Printed composition rules and interface contexts are related but not identical.
## Applicability and exceptions
Preserve exact code, identifiers, machine-readable values and intentional source quotations rather than blindly normalizing every character. Visually similar Cyrillic/Latin characters can require explicit context for an identifier, not a claim that a font can infer the alphabet. Hard breaks, unbreakable groups, punctuation substitutions and tracking need checks in the actual control, width and enlarged-text conditions. Necessary wrapping, a justified truncation route or a locale-specific editorial convention can be legitimate. No blanket ban on all breaks, fixed leading/measure, universal expansion percentage or one native/browser font follows.
## Evidence boundary
The source's attribution for some Russian editorial claims is incomplete and the requested Birman comparison is absent. This qualified working synthesis is not a completed language/style authority study. Verify a consequential contested editorial claim against the applicable source rather than turning these examples into a linter that rewrites literal meaning. Native scaling and web spacing overrides retain their distinct evidence boundaries.

records.title: Separate reusable definitions from local product compositions
triggers: Components resemble one another but have different semantic or interaction responsibilities
Choose reuse, extension, composition or a new definition
records.body:
# Separate reusable definitions from local product compositions

## Meaning
A style guide, token set, component library and task pattern solve different parts of reuse. A useful system connects shared definitions, intent, actual consumers and a way to maintain changes; merely similar pictures do not establish reuse. Reuse an existing contract when meaning, behavior and permitted presentation fit. Extend for a capability of that abstraction; compose existing contracts for a larger task; create when the required contract is different. A deliberate fork also transfers maintenance responsibility.

## Applicability and exceptions
Keep a domain pattern local until the intended shared meaning is supported. Similar rows can differ in selection, navigation, identity or obligations. A feature composition can legitimately know its domain while a generic core control need not. Atomic Design helps reason about parts and wholes; it is not a required folder tree, production sequence or universal taxonomy. Shared core should not silently depend on one consuming domain. No fixed reuse count, component catalogue, token quota or corporate governance apparatus defines validity. An existing mature library may already be the right owner.

## Evidence boundary
Conditional architectural synthesis, not proof of a constructed library, reduced delivery cost or arbitrary scale. Local components and deliberately literal values are not automatically defects. Growth mechanisms need relevant consumer/migration evidence when claimed.

records.title: Define a component by anatomy, behavior and a usable public contract
triggers: Specify a reusable component beyond its default picture
Decide whether a property belongs to the public API or to runtime/domain state
records.body:
# Define a component by anatomy, behavior and a usable public contract

## Meaning
Describe the component's purpose, meaningful parts, inputs/content, events, relevant states and valid transitions, composition limits, adaptation and accessibility responsibilities. A public property expresses a caller's supported choice. Internal hover, press or focus and long-lived domain state have different owners. A visual state specimen can document runtime appearance without making every transient state a caller-set property. Tokens express design decisions, not an entire operation or business state machine.

## Applicability and exceptions
Use the states the actual control and target support; do not require hover, error, loading or every theme on every component. Selection and opening may be controlled or internal according to the real ownership contract, not a universal ban on controlled props. Slots permit bounded composition, not arbitrary destruction of meaning. A product-specific composition can own product behavior; a generic Button need not decide where data is saved. Platform implementations may expose different APIs while preserving shared intent. Keep disabled, pending and remote outcome distinct.

## Evidence boundary
This is a contract-selection aid, not a required schema or proof that a design component implements runtime behavior. A documented accessible primitive can be broken by its consumer's labels, markup, styles or orchestration. Verify the affected contract in the relevant implementation.

records.title: Model theme, surface, content and state as distinct axes
triggers: A variant set multiplies theme, platform, state and content combinations
Nested or inverse surfaces behave differently from the global theme
records.body:
# Model theme, surface, content and state as distinct axes

## Meaning
Theme, brand, density, platform, interaction state, content and surface context can vary for different reasons. Give each actual axis its appropriate owner instead of encoding their full Cartesian product in names or variants. Theme or brand can resolve groups of values; interaction state often belongs to the control; content length is representative input; platform divergence can belong to a separate implementation. An inverse or accent surface can exist within a light theme, so inverse is not simply another spelling of dark.

## Applicability and exceptions
A finite variant set is valid when it expresses meaningful supported choices. Boolean properties are not automatically superior: they can permit impossible combinations. Represent valid combinations and relevant interactions explicitly. Context resolution must preserve intended foreground/background relationships through nested surfaces. Shared semantic intent does not require identical platform colors or a single high-contrast/reduced-motion boolean with undefined cross-platform meaning. Modes, tokens, slots and variants are alternatives chosen by the real contract, not compulsory layers.

## Evidence boundary
The source diagrams illustrate architecture. They do not prove a resolver, nested cascade, native preference response or accessible contrast. Check the supported contexts and actual composited surfaces; palette labels and a default-theme screenshot are insufficient.

records.title: Extract a system without inventing what a concept approved
triggers: Derive reusable definitions from an image, moodboard, editable design or generated concept
Fill missing states while preserving accepted visual intent
records.body:
# Extract a system without inventing what a concept approved

## Meaning
A concept may establish perceptible direction, hierarchy, density, brand character and constraints while leaving states, exact values and domain behavior unknown. Distinguish observed properties, inferred patterns, proposed additions, accepted decisions and unresolved questions. Repeated pixels do not automatically justify separate global tokens. Conversely, normalizing an intentional characteristic away can destroy the accepted direction. From-scratch work can generate a concept first; an existing approved design is also sufficient input.

## Applicability and exceptions
A raster image exposes less structure than an editable component file; code can reveal an API without revealing why it was chosen. Neither implies unseen runtime correctness. Complete ordinary reversible details within existing authority and accepted intent; do not request renewed approval for every spacing value. A material departure or a missing consequential product choice needs its actual owner. Existing authorization and local project agreements take precedence over a source's proposed approval sequence. Do not invent creator acceptance from an example.

## Evidence boundary
The reports' task-management concepts and approvals were fictional. They illustrate extraction, not observed taste, usability or tool reliability. A representative composition should expose relevant missing states/content/context before broad expansion; it is not a fixed required screen inventory or an automatic new test campaign.

records.title: Choose a behavioral foundation by fit and maintenance responsibility
triggers: Choose system, themed, composed or custom controls
Consider replacing a mature UI foundation or hiding platform APIs behind wrappers
records.body:
# Choose a behavioral foundation by fit and maintenance responsibility

## Meaning
Compare retaining system behavior, theming it, composing existing controls and implementing a custom control by the required semantics, accepted visual intent and maintenance cost. A thin product wrapper can stabilize intent while leaving platform behavior intact. A universal wrapper that hides needed navigation, focus, input or presentation APIs can become a costly second framework. In an existing coherent product, establish the actual blocker and replacement cost before choosing a new foundation.

## Applicability and exceptions
Native-first means using suitable platform semantics, not banning libraries or requiring every platform to look identical. Headless behavior can be useful for complex interactions while presentation stays product-owned. A styled library is a reasonable fit when its contract matches; a mature existing stack should not be replaced for theoretical purity. Custom behavior is justified when an essential interaction cannot be expressed otherwise, with the associated accessibility and maintenance responsibility. Shared business logic, shared UI rendering and shared semantic contracts are different choices. An Android-only component needs no artificial iOS counterpart.

## Evidence boundary
Library comparisons are architectural judgments, not measured speed, agent-success or accessibility rankings. No specific framework, latest appearance, OS version or package pin is mandated here. Check actual project versions and current primary prerequisites when choosing an implementation. The reports contain uncompiled examples and no native execution.

records.title: Evolve shared definitions through actual compatibility and consumer boundaries
triggers: A shared token/component change affects several consumers
Decide whether to split a library, add tooling or retire an old identifier
records.body:
# Evolve shared definitions through actual compatibility and consumer boundaries

## Meaning
Distinguish a value change under the same meaning, a semantic change, an API/identifier change and a platform-only dependency update. Inspect actual known consumers and owned regions; visual similarity does not make these changes equivalent. Even an additive property can change compatibility through its default behavior, event, role or interaction. When consumers cannot move together, use an explicit compatibility/migration path and retire old usage only after reviewing remaining dependents.

## Applicability and exceptions
A split is useful for independent ownership, consumers, permissions, release cadence, optional dependencies or discovery/performance pressure. Component count alone is not a universal threshold, but actual file performance is a legitimate reason to partition. Preserve identities and dependency direction rather than copying core into each domain. Small coordinated projects can migrate atomically; they need no fixed deprecation duration or enterprise roster. Add preview, automation, token builds or governance when repeated coordination/failure cost justifies them. An OS/library update need not rename shared semantics or update unaffected targets.

## Evidence boundary
Designed extensibility, a described second domain and observed large-product reliability are different claims. Adoption percentage, fewer raw values and passing component snapshots do not alone establish product quality or savings. Company productivity figures remain reported examples, not causal estimates for the current project. Migration success requires checks of the changed consumers.

records.title: Preserve interaction semantics beyond a component's visual state
triggers: A control looks right but lacks meaningful role, name, state or input behavior
A modal, validation error or async status needs accessible interaction
records.body:
# Preserve interaction semantics beyond a component's visual state

## Meaning
A usable control needs appropriate role, name, value/state and relationships, plus the input/focus behavior its task requires. Prefer suitable platform primitives where they preserve those semantics. Color or a familiar icon alone does not supply an accessible name or textual error explanation. A keyboard or touch path must cover essential work that a hover enhancement exposes. Relevant status changes should be perceivable without indiscriminate focus moves or interruptive alerts.

## Applicability and exceptions
For a web modal, semantics and actual modality must agree: focus enters the modal, keyboard traversal stays within it, dismissal works, and focus returns to a logical place. Initial focus depends on content and risk; Cancel is not a universal default. A decorative border or a dialog-shaped panel does not establish that behavior. See [WAI-ARIA APG modal guidance](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/dialog-modal/).
Use the actual target and applicable conformance criteria, including their exceptions; native touch recommendations, web minimums, focus visibility and focus-appearance criteria are not one cross-platform number or compliance level. An icon-only control can have a meaningful programmatic name without a visible label everywhere.

## Evidence boundary
Selected APG guidance was rechecked during reconciliation. The reports' other accessibility claims remain qualified, not a new conformance audit. A library promise or scanner pass does not certify the composed application. Relevant assistive, keyboard and human checks answer different questions; not every editorial change needs all of them.

records.title: Check browser component boundaries in their actual integration
triggers: A reusable browser component fails in portals, nested themes, SSR or another input context
Choose styling isolation or assess performance/compatibility claims
records.body:
# Check browser component boundaries in their actual integration

## Meaning
A component integrates with cascade, containing layout, direction, portals/overlays, rendering environment and dependencies. Give intended styling overrides a public contract rather than depending on incidental ancestors or private library selectors. Native elements, thin components, headless and styled libraries have different integration responsibilities. Shadow boundaries or a headless label do not automatically establish isolation, accessible composition or low cost.

## Applicability and exceptions
Adapt to the actual component container when that is the constraint; viewport-wide shell decisions can still use viewport conditions. Test actual localized content, nested surfaces and overlays; a correct page direction does not prove its portalled content. Forced colors, input capabilities and optional motion require their own relevant checks. SSR is optional by project need; documented SSR support does not prove hydration of the actual framework/library/version combination. Measure shipped JS/CSS and route interaction when performance matters instead of inferring speed from library names. Engine automation is useful but does not establish every Safari/device/assistive combination.

## Evidence boundary
The web report ran no browser, build, assistive or performance experiment. Package pins and API details are dated reference. Narrow viewport or device-scale emulation is not a complete browser-zoom test. These integration checks do not select a framework or demand all-browser testing for every component edit.

records.title: Preserve typed token meaning through explicit tool and platform transforms
triggers: Map a semantic token to Figma variables/styles and platform resources
Assume a copied JSON example or numeric label is portable and lossless
records.body:
# Preserve typed token meaning through explicit tool and platform transforms

## Meaning
A semantic decision, serialized token, Figma variable, text style and runtime resource are related representations, not interchangeable objects. Declare how types, aliases, units, composite properties, theme context and unsupported values transform. A canvas number alone does not reveal a CSS unit or native physical size. A numeric color label does not determine alpha; inspect actual values and compositing. A gradient's stops and positions form a composite relationship; independent endpoints are useful only when they have their own role.

## Applicability and exceptions
For the checked [DTCG 2025.10 format](https://www.designtokens.org/tr/2025.10/format/), composite types retain typed structure. Read the separate dimensions meaning for its versioned dimension representation. Its [color module](https://www.designtokens.org/tr/2025.10/color/) uses a color-space/components object with optional alpha, rather than a literal hex string as the entire resolved color value. Aliases can still be references. Do not copy the historical R036 example as wholly conforming after repairing dimensions alone. Other application formats can validly serialize colors or dimensions as strings. DTCG is a Community Group specification, not a W3C Recommendation.

## Evidence boundary
Selected versioned format/color provisions were rechecked; no resolver, Figma transformation or native pipeline was executed. Parsing valid JSON is not type/reference/interoperability validation. The source's transformer support, tool types and API details remain dated; verify the subset and actual project consumers before promising a lossless round trip.
